format: UCWDC contests, contiguous order of a division's heats

source.quote_free_summary: When a division requires multiple heats, those heats 'must be run in a contiguous order, one right after another'; for co-mingled divisions the heats 'must still be run' contiguously.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must schedule all heats of a division contiguously, including co-mingled cases.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body's scoring profile. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: planner, SQL, UI changes.
interpretation_notes: Mandatory ('must'). Whether Studio schedules a division's heats contiguously was not verified; the 10D planner groups by division and dance/run unit but also packs heats into earliest floor heats with the same music key, so contiguity is not guaranteed and is not claimed.
decision_refs: OD-25 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now for Studio/Custom heat planning; Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
